raw.rationale: Nicotine is a non-cytotoxic nicotinic acetylcholine receptor agonist that at 2.5 µM for 5 days produces minimal growth inhibition across most cancer lines, with no established lineage-selective killing; PRISM/CTRP data show only weak, non-selective effects, so selective lineage probabilities are near the low end of the baseline range. Slight enrichment is possible in lung and upper aerodigestive lineages due to nAChR expression, but evidence for selective lethality is very weak.
